9 routes. Base URL: `https://orbitwrite.com/api/v1`. Paths below are absolute.

### GET /api/v1/campaigns

List a workspace's campaigns

Requires `campaign:read`. Returns the organization's campaigns, newest first, each with a post count and the next upcoming scheduled post.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | no | Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace. |

**Responses**

- `200` — The workspace's campaigns
  - `CampaignList`
    - `campaigns`: array of `Campaign`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `title`: string | null, required
      - `description`: string | null, required — The campaign's context/source text.
      - `color`: string, required
      - `icon`: string | null, required
      - `startDate`: string | null, required — ISO 8601
      - `endDate`: string | null, required — ISO 8601
      - `postCount`: integer, required — Every post generated for the campaign, any status
      - `nextScheduledAt`: string | null, required — ISO 8601 of the soonest still-upcoming scheduled post
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/campaigns

Create a bare campaign

Requires `campaign:create`. Creates a campaign with no posts. The AI wizard generates posts separately; this is the lightweight counterpart used by the create modal and inline composer form.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `CreateCampaignBody`
  - `organizationId`: string — Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace.
  - `title`: string (max length 200), required
  - `description`: string (max length 4000)
  - `color`: one of `"grey"` | `"dark-grey"` | `"purple"` | `"blue"` | `"teal"` | `"green"` | `"yellow"` | `"orange"` | `"pink"` | `"red"` — Palette color id (shares the tag palette). Omit to keep the default.
  - `icon`: string | null (max length 64) — Avatar icon as a prefixed string: `emoji:🚀` for a raw emoji, or `hi:Rocket01` for a curated hugeicon. Null clears it back to the letter monogram.
  - `startDate`: string (date-time) | null
  - `endDate`: string (date-time) | null

**Responses**

- `200` — The created campaign
  - `CampaignRefResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
    - `campaign`: `CampaignRef`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `title`: string | null, required
      - `description`: string | null, required
      - `color`: string, required
      - `icon`: string | null, required
      - `startDate`: string | null, required
      - `endDate`: string | null, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### GET /api/v1/campaigns/search

Search campaigns by name

Requires `campaign:read`. Case-insensitive substring match against the campaign title, scoped to the organization. LIKE metacharacters in the query match literally. Powers the command menu's campaign search. Returns at most 20 campaigns, newest first.

**Auth:** API key or session
**Rate limited:** yes (429 when the per-credential budget is spent)

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | no | Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace. |
| `q` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — Matching campaigns, newest first
  - `SearchCampaignsResult`
    - `items`: array of `SearchCampaignItem`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `title`: string | null, required
      - `color`: string, required
      - `icon`: string | null, required — Prefixed avatar-icon string (`emoji:🚀` / `hi:Rocket01`), or null when the campaign has no custom icon.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `429` — Rate limit exceeded
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/campaigns/{campaignId}/decision

Approve or reject a campaign

Requires `approval:decide` — green-lighting a campaign is the same authority as approving a post. Approving releases the campaign's still-pending posts into the scheduled queue; rejecting drops them back to Drafts. Creating a campaign takes only `campaign:create`; deciding one is a separate authority.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `campaignId` | string | yes |  |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `CampaignDecisionBody`
  - `decision`: one of `"approved"` | `"rejected"`, required
  - `comment`: string | null (max length 1000)

**Responses**

- `200` — The decision was recorded
  - `CampaignDecisionResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
    - `decision`: one of `"approved"` | `"rejected"`, required
    - `postCount`: integer, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`
- `409` — Conflicts with an existing resource
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/campaigns/generate

Generate a campaign's posts from an approved topic plan

Requires `campaign:create`. Fans out AI generation across the selected accounts and persists a campaign with one composer group per topic, each post held in pending_approval until the campaign is approved.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)
**Rate limited:** yes (429 when the per-credential budget is spent)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `GenerateCampaignBody`
  - `campaignId`: string | null — Attach the generated posts to this already-created bare campaign instead of minting a new one.
  - `title`: string | null (max length 200)
  - `source`: string (max length 4000), required — The article URL or free-text brief the campaign promotes.
  - `timelineType`: one of `"date"` | `"evergreen"`, required
  - `targetDate`: string (date-time) | null
  - `duration`: string (max length 40)
  - `adaptPerPlatform`: boolean
  - `accountIds`: array of string (min 1 items), required
  - `topics`: array of object (min 1 items, max 40 items), required
    - `scheduledAt`: string (date-time), required
    - `topic`: string (max length 280), required

**Responses**

- `200` — The campaign and its generated posts were created
  - `GenerateCampaignResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
    - `campaignId`: string, required
    - `postCount`: integer, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`
- `429` — Rate limit exceeded
